topic.title: Image Restoration and Reliable Signal Enhancement
topic.overview: Restoration recovers useful structure from noisy, blurred, poorly illuminated, or low-resolution observations. The represented methods combine models of degradation with learned image or signal priors. Iterative optimization, neural architectures, diffusion processes, and consistency models offer different ways to balance reconstruction quality, computational cost, and resistance to artifacts.
topic.whyItMatters: A sharper output is not necessarily a more faithful measurement. Effective restoration must preserve weak evidence while avoiding invented detail or excessive suppression, particularly when noise makes local features unreliable.
topic.evolution: The examples begin with mean-field restoration of range images in 1988 and later Bayesian super-resolution. Neural deconvolution and encoder-decoder models appear in the 2010s; recent papers use stochastic dynamics and few-step consistency methods. Newer multi-view signal enhancement emphasizes reliability under very low signal-to-noise conditions.
openQuestions: How can restoration confidence distinguish recovered evidence from a learned prior’s plausible guess?
Can fast models remain reliable across unfamiliar mixtures of degradation?

papers.tldr: CPL-IQA improves semi-supervised image quality assessment by iteratively refining pseudo-labels and learning their confidence.

papers.title: Task-Gated Multi-Expert Collaboration Network for Degraded Multi-Modal Image Fusion
papers.tldr: TG-ECNet coordinates restoration experts and multimodal fusion through task-aware gates to handle degraded images.

papers.title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling for Image Super-Resolution
papers.tldr: VARSR combines next-scale autoregressive generation with conditioning and diffusion refinement for efficient, faithful, and realistic image super-resolution.

papers.title: 4KAgent: Agentic Any Image to 4K Super-Resolution
papers.tldr: 4KAgent coordinates image assessment, restoration planning, and specialist models to upscale diverse degraded images to 4K.

papers.title: Bio-Inspired Image Restoration
papers.tldr: BioIR exchanges broad context and fine detail through two vision-inspired modules to deliver efficient image restoration across multiple degradation settings.

papers.title: BlurDM: A Blur Diffusion Model for Image Deblurring
papers.tldr: BlurDM incorporates blur formation into diffusion and jointly removes blur and noise, improving existing deblurring methods on four benchmark datasets.

papers.title: ControlFusion: A Controllable Image Fusion Network with Language-Vision Degradation Prompts
papers.tldr: ControlFusion combines text instructions and visual degradation assessment to adapt image restoration and fusion to compound image damage.

papers.title: D-VST: Diffusion Transformer for Pathology-Correct Tone-Controllable Cross-Dye Virtual Staining of Whole Slide Images
papers.tldr: D-VST separates pathology from color tone and adapts patch sampling to produce controllable virtual staining of whole-slide tissue images.

papers.title: DeblurDiff: Real-Word Image Deblurring with Generative Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: DeblurDiff repeatedly predicts spatially adaptive latent-space filters to guide diffusion-based deblurring while preserving information from the blurry input.

papers.title: Degradation-Aware Dynamic Schrödinger Bridge for Unpaired Image Restoration
papers.tldr: DDSB combines unpaired distribution learning with physical degradation knowledge to improve iterative image restoration.

papers.title: Delving into Cascaded Instability: A Lipschitz Continuity View on Image Restoration and Object Detection Synergy
papers.tldr: LR-YOLO integrates restoration with detector training to address sensitivity mismatches, improving stability and accuracy on haze and low-light benchmarks.

papers.title: Deno-IF: Unsupervised Noisy Visible and Infrared Image Fusion Method
papers.tldr: Deno-IF jointly denoises and fuses noisy visible and infrared images using an unsupervised framework guided by low-rank structure.

papers.title: Dual-Comb Ghost Imaging with Transformer-Based Reconstruction for Optical Fiber Endomicroscopy
papers.tldr: A single-core fiber imaging system combines parallel optical measurements with transformer reconstruction for fast, compact endomicroscopy.

papers.title: Efficient RAW Image Deblurring with Adaptive Frequency Modulation
papers.tldr: FrENet improves RAW-image deblurring efficiency and quality by adaptively processing frequency components and preserving high-frequency detail.

papers.title: FIPER: Factorized Features for Robust Image Super-Resolution and Compression
papers.tldr: FIPER represents image features through bases, coefficients, and explicit frequencies to improve both super-resolution and compression.

papers.title: From Softmax to Score: Transformers Can Effectively Implement In-Context Denoising Steps
papers.tldr: The paper establishes exact links between Transformer attention and several denoising algorithms, supported by image-denoising experiments with and without context.

papers.title: Image Super-Resolution with Guarantees via Conformalized Generative Models
papers.tldr: Conformal prediction produces local confidence masks for black-box super-resolution models, with guarantees tied to a chosen image similarity metric.

papers.title: InstructRestore: Region-Customized Image Restoration with Human Instructions
papers.tldr: InstructRestore follows region descriptions to apply different restoration strengths across an image, including controllable background blur.

papers.title: Jasmine: Harnessing Diffusion Prior for Self-supervised Depth Estimation
papers.tldr: Jasmine combines image reconstruction and scale-shift adaptation to use Stable Diffusion’s visual priors for self-supervised depth estimation.

papers.title: MODEM: A Morton-Order Degradation Estimation Mechanism for Adverse Weather Image Recovery
papers.tldr: MODEM estimates global and local weather degradation to adapt image restoration, achieving reported state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: OCTDiff: Bridged Diffusion Model for Portable OCT Super-Resolution and Enhancement
papers.tldr: OCTDiff combines specialized diffusion denoising, multiscale attention, and clinically guided training to improve portable OCT image quality.

papers.title: scSplit: Bringing Severity Cognizance to Image Decomposition in Fluorescence Microscopy
papers.tldr: scSplit estimates signal-mixing asymmetry and uses it to adapt fluorescence image separation to varying relative intensities.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Selective-Guided Diffusion Model for Old-Photo Face Restoration
papers.tldr: SSDiff uses generated face references and region-specific, staged diffusion guidance to restore damaged old photographs.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Blind-Spot Image Denoising via Cross-Scale Non-Local Pixel Refilling
papers.tldr: The method improves blind-spot denoising by refilling masked pixels with distant, similar observations that have less-correlated noise.

papers.title: Zero-shot Denoising via Neural Compression: Theoretical and algorithmic framework
papers.tldr: ZS-NCD denoises a single image using an initially untrained compression network whose entropy constraints control overfitting.

papers.title: Bend the Basics: Degradation-Aware Deformable Tokenization for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.tldr: FIT adapts patch sampling and reconstruction to local image damage, improving unified restoration across multiple degradation settings.

papers.title: Coloring the Noise: Adversarial Sobolev Alignment for Faithful Image Super Resolution
papers.tldr: ASASR reshapes training noise and constructs adversarial structural errors to improve the fidelity of generative image super-resolution.

papers.title: Degradation-Aware Metric Prompting for Hyperspectral Image Restoration
papers.tldr: DAMP uses interpretable spatial-spectral corruption measurements to route hyperspectral images through specialized restoration experts.

papers.title: Discontinuous Galerkin Neural Operator for Pathology Defocus Deblurring
papers.tldr: DGNO models local blur differences and their interfaces to improve pathology image deblurring while preserving optical structure.

papers.title: Enhanced Latent-Space Adversarial Training for Super-Resolution
papers.tldr: HYPIR++ combines latent-space adversarial learning with more efficient attention to improve super-resolution quality and run 1.71 times faster than HYPIR.

papers.title: Fully Zero-Shot Image Dehazing
papers.tldr: A diffusion dehazing framework learns entirely from clean images by conditioning on representations shared by clean and hazy scenes.

papers.title: Image Restoration via Diffusion Models with Dynamic Resolution
papers.tldr: Dynamic-resolution diffusion methods accelerate image restoration while improving reconstruction results in most reported experimental settings.

papers.title: Normalization Equivariance for Arbitrary Backbones, with Application to Image Denoising
papers.tldr: A parameter-free normalization wrapper enforces normalization equivariance for arbitrary backbones and improves denoising robustness without measurable GPU overhead.

papers.title: Normalization-equivariant Diffusion Models: Learning Posterior Samplers From Noisy And Partial Measurements
papers.tldr: A scale-equivariance-based training strategy learns restoration diffusion models from noisy, potentially incomplete measurements from a single operator.

papers.title: One-Step Residual Shifting Diffusion for Image Super-Resolution via Distillation
papers.tldr: RSD distills ResShift into single-step super-resolution, improving reported perceptual metrics while reducing resource demands relative to text-to-image-based methods.

papers.title: Q-DiT4SR: Exploration of Detail-Preserving Diffusion Transformer Quantization for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.tldr: Q-DiT4SR tailors quantization to diffusion-transformer super-resolution, preserving detail while substantially reducing model size and computation.

papers.title: RevealLayer: Disentangling Hidden and Visible Layers via Occlusion-Aware Image Decomposition
papers.tldr: RevealLayer separates natural images into transparent layers using occlusion-aware diffusion components and introduces supporting data and benchmarks.

papers.title: Robust Signal Enhancement via Fractional Detail Views and Knowledge Guided Multi-view Fusion
papers.tldr: FracKGMF combines long-tailed signal aggregation with reliability-guided fusion to improve enhancement under very strong noise.

papers.title: TPGDiff : Hierarchical Triple-Prior Guided Diffusion for Image Restoration
papers.tldr: TPGDiff places structural, semantic, and degradation guidance at complementary layers and timesteps to improve unified image restoration.

papers.title: Unifying Heterogeneous Degradations: Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Bridge Model for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.tldr: UDBM uses pixelwise uncertainty and a relaxed diffusion bridge to unify diverse image-restoration tasks in one inference step.
